propositions: complexity-baseline.json has no CI lock mechanism unlike module-size-limit.txt, allowing unchecked contributor changes to land
new high-complexity functions can be admitted by adding baseline entries, bypassing the ratchet because entry count grows with stale remaining empty
the module-size lock emits a warning and continues on failed git fetch of main, executing the cap at an unverified limit value from the current branch
the complexity baseline gate must compare ceilings entries semantically against main: rejecting raised or added entries, allowing removed or lowered entries
a semantic shrink-only lock distinguishes legitimate refactoring (entry removal, ceiling lowering) from illegitimate growth (entry addition, ceiling raising) to keep the ratchet usable
the module-size lock must also fail closed on fetch failure rather than warning and skipping verification
